GADGET / PM — MSE-HEALTH-HISTORY-20261121-06 r1 continuation.

User confirms native Apple Health export is prepared. AirDrop receipt and protected local custody are not yet confirmed; ZIP must remain closed and out of chat. NICKY owns metadata-only expected-file intake into the approved encrypted staging, retaining the original. No real historical data import is claimed.

Verified GitHub heads: Mother draft #50 a01d478fc897ba06014f49f421ef8c7cb4851187; MotherHealthBridge draft #17 cb473b77536d1fb5bf984b9de547e83bc85e67b7. Both remain open drafts, not merged. Mother CI succeeded; both pre-commit jobs failed. No typed 8448 deployment or real grant is active. Prior ciphertext-only 8447 synthetic qualification and closure were independently reviewed; local custodian authentication of the exact retained fixture remains a separate gap.

Next work sent to all eight existing chats: FORGE fixes actual CI failures and reconciles the server wire; ATLAS publishes explicit resolution of r4 contract differences (pending discriminator, expired lookup and signed commit interface); ORACLE verifies exact nonempty cross-wire pending/restart/final receipt behavior and signed app; SENTINEL reviews key/role/witness and cutoff safety; PROVENANCE verifies package lineage and actual external decrypt-to-typed proof; PHOENIX prepares isolated disabled 8448 staging, with finite synthetic qualification only after independent candidate review; NICKY handles protected local intake and independent app acceptance; LONESTAR refreshes the single stage board.

Delivery accepted by the eight chat tools. This is dispatch, not acknowledgment or execution. Backend/app tests reported by authors are not independent cross-wire/runtime proof. Real history transfer waits for reviewed custody and exact end-to-end evidence. Preserve the running 8446 pilot, enrollment and cutoff; no fixture resend, private age key on VM, real Nightscout access, LLM forwarding, public exposure or main merge. Backups/restores remain deferred.
